papers.title: YOLOv11: An Overview of the Key Architectural Enhancements
papers.authors: Rahima Khanam, Muhammad Hussain
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Huddersfield University, Queensgate, Huddersfield HD1 3DH, UK
papers.intro: 本文详细剖析了YOLOv11在骨干网络（C3k2、SPPF、C2PSA）、颈部（C3k2）和头部（C3k2、CBS）架构上的关键创新，展示了其在5个计算机视觉任务上的扩展能力，并验证了其相比前代在参数效率和检测精度上的提升。

papers.title: SPA-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for SmartPhone Agent Evaluation
papers.authors: Jingxuan Chen, Derek Yuen, Bin Xie, Yuhao Yang, Gongwei Chen, Zhihao Wu, Li Yixing, Xurui Zhou, Weiwen Liu, Shuai Wang, Kaiwen Zhou, Rui Shao, Liqiang Nie, Yasheng Wang, Jianye Hao, Jun Wang, Kun Shao
papers.affiliations: 1Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab; 2Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen; 3Tianjin University; 4AI Centre, University College London
papers.intro: SPA-Bench 是一个面向智能手机智能体的综合性基准，包含340个跨中英文、跨单/多应用、难度分层的任务，集成11种主流智能体，并提出无需人工干预的自动化评估流水线，通过7个指标对智能体的任务完成度和资源消耗进行全面衡量。

papers.title: DistRL: An Asynchronous Distributed Reinforcement Learning Framework for On-Device Control Agents
papers.authors: Taiyi Wang, Zhihao Wu, Jianheng Liu, Jianye Hao, Jun Wang, Kun Shao
papers.affiliations: University of Cambridge, Powersense Technology Limited, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, University College London, Tianjin University
papers.intro: DistRL是一个异步分布式强化学习框架，通过集中式训练与去中心化数据采集解耦，结合定制的A-RIDE算法，大幅提升移动设备控制agent在线RL微调的训练效率与任务成功率。

papers.title: Harnessing Webpage UIs for Text-Rich Visual Understanding
papers.authors: Junpeng Liu, Tianyue Ou, Yifan Song, Yuxiao Qu, Wai Lam, Chenyan Xiong, Wenhu Chen, Graham Neubig, Xiang Yue
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Peking University, University of Waterloo
papers.intro: 本文提出利用网页UI的访问树（accessibility tree）和文本大语言模型合成多模态指令数据，构建了7.3M样本的MultiUI数据集，训练后的模型不仅大幅提升网页UI任务性能（如VisualWebBench提升48%），还意外地泛化到文档理解、OCR、图表等非UI领域，验证了网页UI数据…

papers.title: MobA: Multifaceted Memory-Enhanced Adaptive Planning for Efficient Mobile Task Automation
papers.authors: Zichen Zhu, Hao Tang, Yansi Li, Dingye Liu, Hongshen Xu, Kunyao Lan, Danyang Zhang, Yixuan Jiang, Hao Zhou, Chenrun Wang, Situo Zhang, Liangtai Sun, Yixiao Wang, Yuheng Sun, Lu Chen, Kai Yu
papers.intro: 本文提出MobA，一个基于MLLM的移动助手系统，通过引入自适应规划模块（包含反射机制）和多层面记忆模块，能够动态调整任务计划以适应真实环境上下文和动作执行能力，从而高效完成复杂移动任务。

papers.title: Agent S: An Open Agentic Framework that Uses Computers Like a Human
papers.authors: Saaket Agashe, Jiuzhou Han, Shuyu Gan, Jiachen Yang, Ang Li, Xin Eric Wang
papers.intro: Agent S是一个开源的代理框架，通过“经验增强的层次化规划”（结合外部网络知识和内部记忆检索）与“代理-计算机接口（ACI）”，使多模态大模型（MLLM）能够像人类一样自主操作计算机GUI，在OSWorld基准上达到新最优。

papers.title: Navigating the Digital World as Humans Do: Universal Visual Grounding for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Boyu Gou, Ruohan Wang, Boyuan Zheng, Yanan Xie, Cheng Chang, Yiheng Shu, Huan Sun, Yu Su
papers.affiliations: The Ohio State University（Boyu Gou, Ruohan Wang, Boyuan Zheng, Yiheng Shu, Huan Sun, Yu Su）；Orby AI（Yanan Xie, Cheng Chang）
papers.intro: 本文提出UGround，一种基于网络合成数据和LLaVA架构简单调整的通用视觉定位模型，并构建了迄今最大GUI视觉定位数据集，使仅依赖视觉感知的GUI智能体在多个基准上超越使用额外文本输入的现有最先进智能体。

papers.title: Grounded-VideoLLM: Sharpening Fine-grained Temporal Grounding in Video Large Language Models
papers.authors: Haibo Wang, Zhiyang Xu, Yu Cheng, Shizhe Diao, Yufan Zhou, Yixin Cao, Qifan Wang, Weifeng Ge, Lifu Huang
papers.affiliations: University of California, Davis; Virginia Tech; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; NVIDIA; Adobe Research; Fudan University; Meta AI
papers.intro: 本文提出Grounded-VideoLLM，通过引入双流编码器（空间流+时间流）和带结构化时间知识的离散时间令牌，并配合渐进式多阶段训练，显著增强了视频大语言模型的细粒度时间定位与时间推理能力。

papers.title: MobileVLM: A Vision-Language Model for Better Intra- and Inter-UI Understanding
papers.authors: Qinzhuo Wu, Weikai Xu, Wei Liu, Tao Tan, Jianfeng Liu, Ang Li, Jian Luan, Bin Wang, Shuo Shang
papers.affiliations: 1XiaoMi AI Lab, 2University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, 3Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China
papers.intro: 提出MobileVLM，通过在通用预训练基础上增加两个针对移动UI的预训练阶段（含四个特定任务）和构建大规模中文UI图数据集Mobile3M，同时增强页面内元素理解和页面间动作关系建模，在ScreenQA等基准上超越现有VLM。

papers.title: Windows Agent Arena
papers.authors: Unknown
papers.affiliations: Microsoft, Carnegie Mellon University, Columbia University
papers.intro: 本文提出了WindowsAgentArena——一个基于Windows操作系统的可复现、可并行化的多模态agent评估benchmark（含154个任务），并引入了一种新agent Navi，其成功率19.5%，同时展示了benchmark的快速并行评估能力（20分钟内完成）。

papers.title: Agent Workflow Memory
papers.authors: Zora Zhiruo Wang, Jiayuan Mao, Daniel Fried, Graham Neubig
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出 Agent Workflow Memory (AWM)，通过从智能体轨迹中诱导可重用的工作流并将其集成到记忆中以指导后续任务求解，在两大网页导航基准上显著提升了任务成功率并减少了执行步骤。

papers.title: Multi-LoRA Fine-Tuned Segment Anything Model for Urban Man-Made Object Extraction
papers.authors: Qihao Weng; Xiaoyan Lu
papers.intro: 论文提出一种基于多LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）微调Segment Anything Model（SAM）的方法，通过并行训练多个轻量级适配模块来提升模型在城市人造物体分割任务上的性能。

papers.title: Agent Q: Advanced Reasoning and Learning for Autonomous AI Agents
papers.authors: Pranav Putta, Edmund Mills, Naman Garg, Sumeet Motwani, Chelsea Finn, Divyansh Garg, Rafael Rafailov
papers.affiliations: The AGI Company (MultiOn)（作者1-4,6），Stanford University（作者5,7）
papers.intro: 提出了 Agent Q 框架，结合引导式蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）、自我批评机制和基于离策略直接偏好优化（DPO）的迭代微调，显著提升了 LLM 在交互式多步推理任务中的决策性能，在网页导航（WebShop）和真实世界预订场景中超过基线并接近或超越人类水平。

papers.title: VisualAgentBench: Towards Large Multimodal Models as Visual Foundation Agents
papers.authors: Xiao Liu, Tianjie Zhang, Yu Gu, Iat Long Iong, Yifan Xu, Xixuan Song, Shudan Zhang, Hanyu Lai, Xinyi Liu, Hanlin Zhao, Jiadai Sun, Xinyue Yang, Yu Yang, Zehan Qi, Shuntian Yao, Xueqiao Sun, Siyi Cheng, Qinkai Zheng, Hao Yu, Hanchen Zhang, Wenyi Hong, Ming Ding, Lihang Pan, Xiaotao Gu, Aohan Zeng, Zhengxiao Du, Chan Hee Song, Yu Su, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, The Ohio State University, Zhejiang University, Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出VisualAgentBench（VAB），一个包含多个环境（具身、GUI、视觉设计）的综合性基准，用于训练和评估LMMs作为视觉基础代理的能力，并通过混合策略构建训练轨迹集，显著提升开源LMMs的行为克隆效果。

papers.title: Caution for the Environment: Multimodal LLM Agents are Susceptible to Environmental Distractions
papers.authors: Xinbei Ma, Yiting Wang, Yao Yao, Tongxin Yuan, Aston Zhang, Zhuosheng Zhang, Hai Zhao
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学计算机科学学院（1）、上海交通大学上海教委智能交互与认知工程重点实验室（2）、上海交通大学上海市可信数据流通与治理重点实验室（3）、Meta GenAI（4）
papers.intro: 本文首次系统性地研究多模态GUI智能体在良性但存在环境干扰的场景下的忠实性问题，通过构建模拟数据集和多种工作模式，实验表明即使是强大的通用和专用智能体也极易被环境干扰分心，并提出了改进忠实性和对抗性环境注入的分析。

papers.title: AppAgent v2: Advanced Agent for Flexible Mobile Interactions
papers.authors: Yanda Li, Chi Zhang, Wenjia Jiang, Wanqi Yang, Bin Fu, Pei Cheng, Xin Chen, Ling Chen, Yunchao Wei
papers.affiliations: University of Technology Sydney, Tencent, Beijing Jiaotong University, Westlake University
papers.intro: 本文提出一个双阶段（探索与部署）多模态代理框架AppAgent v2，通过构建灵活的动作空间（整合解析器、OCR和视觉描述）和结构化知识库结合RAG技术，显著提升移动设备上GUI交互的适应性和任务执行精度。

papers.title: OmniParser for Pure Vision Based GUI Agent
papers.authors: Yadong Lu, Jianwei Yang, Yelong Shen, Ahmed Awadallah
papers.intro: 提出OmniParser，一种纯视觉的用户界面屏幕解析方法，通过微调交互图标检测模型和图标描述模型，将截图解析为结构化元素，显著提升GPT-4V在GUI任务中的动作定位准确率。

papers.title: MindSearch: Mimicking Human Minds Elicits Deep AI Searcher
papers.authors: Zehui Chen, Kuikun Liu, Qiuchen Wang, Jiangning Liu, Wenwei Zhang, Kai Chen, Feng Zhao
papers.affiliations: MoE Key Laboratory of Brain-inspired Intelligent Perception and Cognition, USTC; Shanghai AI Laboratory
papers.intro: MindSearch提出了一个受人类认知过程启发的多智能体框架，通过WebPlanner动态构建有向无环图分解问题，并并行调度多个WebSearcher进行层次化检索，从而在3分钟内从超过300个网页中高效整合信息，质量超越ChatGPT-Web和Perplexity.ai。

papers.title: LongVideoBench: A Benchmark for Long-context Interleaved Video-Language Understanding
papers.authors: Haoning Wu, Dongxu Li, Bei Chen, Junnan Li
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, video search
papers.intro: 该论文提出了LongVideoBench——一个面向长达一小时、视频与字幕交错输入的多选题问答基准，通过新颖的"Referring Reasoning"任务设计，有效克服了已有视频基准的单帧偏置问题，系统评估了主流闭源和开源多模态大模型在长上下文视频理解上的真实能力。

papers.title: Agent-E: From Autonomous Web Navigation to Foundational Design Principles in Agentic Systems
papers.authors: Tamer Abuelsaad, Deepak Akkil, Prasenjit Dey, Ashish Jagmohan, Aditya Vempaty, Ravi Kokku
papers.intro: 论文提出Agent-E——一种采用分层架构、灵活DOM蒸馏和变化观察机制的Web Agent，在WebVoyager基准上以73.2%成功率超越现有文本/多模态SOTA 10%-30%，并提炼出通用Agent系统设计原则。
